entries.text: Sun in Aries is exalted (uchcha). Gives leadership, courage, independence, strong will, and recognition. Can be domineering or impulsive. Favors government, military, sports, surgery.
Sun in Taurus is steady, materialistic, and artistic. Values financial security and comfort. Strong determination but can be stubborn.
Sun in Gemini is intellectual, communicative, and curious. Good at teaching, writing, business, and multi-tasking. Can be restless.
Sun in Cancer is nurturing, protective, and emotionally sensitive. Strong connection to family and homeland. Can be moody.
Sun in Leo is in own sign (swakshetra). Natural leader, confident, creative, generous, and authoritative. Excellent for politics, arts, and management.
Sun in Virgo is analytical, service-oriented, detail-focused, and health-conscious. Good at administration, medicine, and technical fields.
Sun in Libra is debilitated (neecha). Creates indecision, dependency on partnerships, and self-esteem issues. Gains through diplomacy and relationships after effort.
Sun in Scorpio is intense, secretive, research-oriented, and transformative. Strong willpower and ability to handle crises.
Sun in Sagittarius is philosophical, righteous, optimistic, and teaching-oriented. Favors teaching, law, spirituality, and higher education.
Sun in Capricorn is disciplined, ambitious, practical, and hardworking. Gains through perseverance and government or large organizations.
Sun in Aquarius is humanitarian, innovative, independent, and intellectual. Good at science, technology, social work, and networking.
Sun in Pisces is compassionate, spiritual, imaginative, and intuitive. Favors healing, arts, charity, and spiritual pursuits.
Moon in Aries gives an emotional, impulsive, and enthusiastic nature. Quick reactions, courageous, but can be short-tempered.
Moon in Taurus is exalted (uchcha). Emotionally stable, affectionate, artistic, and prosperous. Strong sense of loyalty and comfort.
Moon in Gemini is mentally active, communicative, adaptable, and sociable. Needs mental stimulation and variety.
Moon in Cancer is in own sign (swakshetra). Deeply nurturing, intuitive, protective, and emotionally rich. Strong family bonds.
Moon in Leo is proud, generous, creative, and warm-hearted. Needs recognition and expresses emotions dramatically.
Moon in Virgo is analytical, health-conscious, and service-oriented. Can be overcritical or anxious emotionally.
Moon in Libra seeks harmony, partnership, and beauty. Diplomatic, romantic, and indecisive at times.
Moon in Scorpio is debilitated (neecha). Intense, secretive, transformative emotions. Can face emotional turbulence but gains deep insight.
Moon in Sagittarius is optimistic, freedom-loving, philosophical, and honest. Needs adventure and higher meaning.
Moon in Capricorn is reserved, responsible, disciplined emotionally. May feel emotionally distant but reliable.
Moon in Aquarius is independent, humanitarian, and intellectual. Values friendship and social causes.
Moon in Pisces is compassionate, dreamy, intuitive, and spiritually inclined. Highly empathetic and artistic.
Mars in Aries is in own sign. Very energetic, courageous, competitive, and action-oriented. Strong leadership but can be aggressive.
Mars in Taurus is determined, practical, and persistent energy. Can be stubborn and possessive.
Mars in Gemini is mentally active, argumentative, and versatile. Good at debates, sales, and quick actions.
Mars in Cancer is debilitated. Emotional impulsiveness, domestic conflicts, but protective of family.
Mars in Leo is bold, courageous, ambitious, and authoritative. Excellent leadership and creative drive.
Mars in Virgo is disciplined, analytical, and service-oriented energy. Good at technical and health-related work.
Mars in Libra is indecisive in action but diplomatic. Energy goes into relationships and partnerships.
Mars in Scorpio is in own sign (co-lord). Intense, penetrating, determined, and secretive. Great research, surgery, and investigative ability.
Mars in Sagittarius is adventurous, philosophical, and energetic. Favors sports, teaching, and exploration.
Mars in Capricorn is exalted. Disciplined, ambitious, hardworking, and strategic. Great for career achievement.
Mars in Aquarius is innovative, rebellious, and humanitarian energy. Good at technology and social reform.
Mars in Pisces is diffused energy, spiritual courage, and creative action. Can lack direction or be escapist.
Mercury in Aries is quick, decisive, and direct communication. Good at leadership roles requiring fast thinking.
Mercury in Taurus is practical, stable, and methodical thinking. Good for finance, arts, and business.
Mercury in Gemini is in own sign. Excellent communication, learning, adaptability, and multi-tasking.
Mercury in Cancer is intuitive, emotional, and memory-oriented thinking. Strong imagination.
Mercury in Leo is confident, dramatic, and authoritative communication. Good at teaching and leadership speech.
Mercury in Virgo is exalted. Analytical, precise, detail-oriented, and excellent for medicine, science, and accounting.
Mercury in Libra is diplomatic, balanced, and artistic communication. Good at law, negotiation, and design.
Mercury in Scorpio is penetrating, investigative, and secretive thinking. Good for research and psychology.
Mercury in Sagittarius is philosophical, optimistic, and broad thinking. Good at teaching, publishing, and law.
Mercury in Capricorn is practical, organized, and strategic thinking. Good for business and administration.
Mercury in Aquarius is innovative, scientific, and unconventional thinking. Excellent for technology and invention.
Mercury in Pisces is debilitated. Intuitive, creative, but can be unclear or impractical in communication.
Jupiter in Aries brings wisdom through action, leadership, and initiative. Optimistic and courageous in beliefs.
Jupiter in Taurus is exalted. Prosperity, wisdom, stability, and artistic appreciation. Strong financial growth potential.
Jupiter in Gemini is curious, communicative, and learns widely. Can be scattered in wisdom.
Jupiter in Cancer is exalted. Nurturing wisdom, strong family values, emotional intelligence, and prosperity.
Jupiter in Leo is in own sign (classic). Noble, generous, wise leadership, and creative intelligence.
Jupiter in Virgo is practical wisdom, service-oriented, and detail-focused spirituality.
Jupiter in Libra brings wisdom through relationships, justice, and balance. Good for counseling and law.
Jupiter in Scorpio gives deep, transformative wisdom and interest in occult, research, and healing.
Jupiter in Sagittarius is in own sign. Philosophical, righteous, spiritual teacher, and fortunate.
Jupiter in Capricorn is debilitated. Wisdom comes through discipline and hardship. Practical spirituality.
Jupiter in Aquarius is humanitarian wisdom, scientific spirituality, and broad social vision.
Jupiter in Pisces is in own sign. Deep spirituality, compassion, intuition, and artistic inspiration.
Venus in Aries is passionate, impulsive in love, and energetic in arts. Can be competitive in relationships.
Venus in Taurus is in own sign. Sensual, artistic, luxurious, stable in love, and financially fortunate.
Venus in Gemini is charming, communicative, and playful in love. Loves variety and intellectual connection.
Venus in Cancer is nurturing, protective, and emotionally deep in love. Strong family attachment.
Venus in Leo is dramatic, romantic, generous, and loyal in love. Loves luxury and admiration.
Venus in Virgo is debilitated. Practical in love, service-oriented, but can be critical or self-sacrificing.
Venus in Libra is in own sign. Harmonious, romantic, artistic, diplomatic, and relationship-oriented.
Venus in Scorpio is intense, passionate, secretive, and transformative in love. Can face relationship power struggles.
Venus in Sagittarius is freedom-loving, philosophical, and adventurous in love. Values honesty and exploration.
Venus in Capricorn is serious, committed, and practical in love. Values status and long-term stability.
Venus in Aquarius is unconventional, friendly, and independent in love. Values friendship in relationships.
Venus in Pisces is exalted. Romantic, compassionate, artistic, spiritually loving, and self-sacrificing.
Saturn in Aries is debilitated. Delays in action, lessons in patience and discipline. Hard-won leadership.
Saturn in Taurus is steady, practical, and disciplined with finances. Slow but stable growth.
Saturn in Gemini is disciplined thinking, serious communication, and methodical learning.
Saturn in Cancer creates emotional restriction and responsibility. Lessons around family and security.
Saturn in Leo challenges ego and authority. Disciplined creativity and mature leadership after effort.
Saturn in Virgo is precise, disciplined, and service-oriented work. Excellent for technical and medical fields.
Saturn in Libra is exalted. Justice, balance, committed relationships, and fair leadership.
Saturn in Scorpio is intense, secretive, and transformative discipline. Handles crises and research well.
Saturn in Sagittarius is disciplined wisdom, structured belief systems, and practical philosophy.
Saturn in Capricorn is in own sign. Highly disciplined, ambitious, responsible, and successful through hard work.
Saturn in Aquarius is in own sign (co-lord). Innovative discipline, humanitarian structures, and scientific approach.
Saturn in Pisces is spiritual discipline, structured compassion, and practical intuition.
Rahu in Aries amplifies courage, ambition, and impulsiveness. Can create obsession with leadership.
Rahu in Taurus is exalted. Strong desire for wealth, comfort, and material success. Good for business.
Rahu in Gemini is exalted. Cunning communication, technology skills, and versatile intelligence.
Rahu in Cancer creates emotional confusion and unconventional family situations.
Rahu in Leo amplifies desire for fame, power, and recognition. Can be dramatic.
Rahu in Virgo gives technical cunning, health focus, and perfectionist tendencies.
Rahu in Libra desires relationships, harmony, and social status. Can be manipulative in partnerships.
Rahu in Scorpio gives intense, secretive, and research-oriented desires. Interest in occult and mysteries.
Rahu in Sagittarius creates unconventional beliefs and philosophical restlessness.
Rahu in Capricorn drives ambition for status, power, and material achievement.
Rahu in Aquarius amplifies technological, social, and humanitarian ambitions.
Rahu in Pisces creates spiritual confusion or unconventional spiritual pursuits.
Ketu in Aries reduces ego and impulsiveness. Spiritual lessons around courage and self-identity.
Ketu in Taurus creates detachment from material comforts. Spiritual lessons around value and security.
Ketu in Gemini creates intuitive but scattered communication. Past-life knowledge.
Ketu in Cancer is exalted. Deep intuitive sensitivity, spiritual family connections, detachment from emotions.
Ketu in Leo reduces need for recognition. Spiritual lessons around humility and leadership.
Ketu in Virgo gives intuitive healing ability and detachment from perfectionism.
Ketu in Libra creates detachment from relationships or karmic partnerships.
Ketu in Scorpio is exalted. Deep occult intuition, transformative spirituality, and research gifts.
Ketu in Sagittarius gives natural wisdom and detachment from dogma. Spiritual teacher potential.
Ketu in Capricorn reduces attachment to status. Spiritual lessons through responsibility.
Ketu in Aquarius gives unconventional spiritual insights and detachment from social groups.
Ketu in Pisces is in own sign (co-lord). Highly spiritual, intuitive, detached, and compassionate.
1st house (Lagna/Ascendant) represents self, body, personality, health, and overall life path. Planets here strongly influence the native.
2nd house represents wealth, family lineage, speech, food, and accumulated resources. Strong planets here support financial stability.
3rd house represents siblings, courage, communication, short travels, skills, and initiative.
4th house represents mother, home, vehicles, happiness, education, and landed property.
5th house represents intelligence, children, romance, education, speculation, and past merit.
6th house represents diseases, enemies, debts, competition, service, and daily obstacles.
7th house represents marriage, partnerships, business alliances, and open enemies.
8th house represents longevity, sudden events, inheritance, occult, transformation, and in-laws.
9th house represents father, fortune, higher education, religion, long travel, and dharma.
10th house represents career, profession, status, government, and public reputation.
11th house represents gains, friends, elder siblings, ambitions, and network circles.
12th house represents losses, expenses, foreign lands, spirituality, isolation, and liberation.

Mangal Dosha occurs when Mars is in 1st, 2nd, 4th, 7th, 8th, or 12th house (some traditions include 1st from Moon/Venus). Creates delays or friction in marriage unless matched with another Manglik or canceled.

Mangal Dosha cancellation can occur if: Mars is in own/exaltation sign, Saturn aspect on Mars, Mars in 1st in Aries, Mars in 8th in Scorpio, Mars in 7th in Capricorn, Mars in 2nd in Virgo, or if partner is also Manglik.
Ashwini nakshatra (Ketu-ruled): Quick, healing, pioneering, energetic. Can be impulsive.
Bharani nakshatra (Venus-ruled): Creative, transformative, bears burdens, intense sexuality.
Krittika nakshatra (Sun-ruled): Sharp, purifying, leadership, critical, transformative.
Rohini nakshatra (Moon-ruled): Beautiful, creative, stable, sensual, fertile.
Mrigashira nakshatra (Mars-ruled): Curious, searching, communicative, restless.
Ardra nakshatra (Rahu-ruled): Emotional storms, transformation, research, healing after pain.
Punarvasu nakshatra (Jupiter-ruled): Renewal, generosity, forgiveness, spiritual growth.
Pushya nakshatra (Saturn-ruled): Nurturing, spiritual, supportive, teaching. Considered highly auspicious.
Ashlesha nakshatra (Mercury-ruled): Secretive, cunning, intuitive, transformative, hypnotic.
Magha nakshatra (Ketu-ruled): Ancestral, royal, tradition, pride, leadership.
Purva Phalguni nakshatra (Venus-ruled): Pleasure, romance, creativity, relaxation, art.
Uttara Phalguni nakshatra (Sun-ruled): Responsible, charitable, stable relationships, service.
Hasta nakshatra (Moon-ruled): Skillful, clever, artistic, healing through hands, communication.
Chitra nakshatra (Mars-ruled): Beautiful, architect, creative, sparkling, illusion.
Swati nakshatra (Rahu-ruled): Independent, adaptable, business-minded, freedom-loving.
Vishakha nakshatra (Jupiter-ruled): Focused, determined, dual-natured, ambitious, spiritual seeker.
Anuradha nakshatra (Saturn-ruled): Devotion, friendship, cooperation, spiritual discipline.
Jyeshtha nakshatra (Mercury-ruled): Senior, protective, occult power, emotional intensity.
Mula nakshatra (Ketu-ruled): Root-level transformation, destruction and renewal, research, healing.
Purva Ashadha nakshatra (Venus-ruled): Invincible, ambitious, water-related, persuasive.
Uttara Ashadha nakshatra (Sun-ruled): Victorious, principled, leadership, perseverance.
Shravana nakshatra (Moon-ruled): Listening, learning, teaching, wisdom, travel.
Dhanishta nakshatra (Mars-ruled): Musical, wealthy, charitable, multifaceted talents.
Shatabhisha nakshatra (Rahu-ruled): Healing, secret knowledge, science, isolation, hundred physicians.
Purva Bhadrapada nakshatra (Jupiter-ruled): Fiery, passionate, spiritual fire, transformation.
Uttara Bhadrapada nakshatra (Saturn-ruled): Wise, stable, charitable, deep spirituality, endurance.
Revati nakshatra (Mercury-ruled): Nurturing, compassionate, artistic, protection, travel.
Remedies for weak Sun: Surya Namaskar on Sunday, donate wheat/jaggery, recite Aditya Hridayam, wear ruby if suitable.
Remedies for weak Moon: Chant Chandra mantra, worship Shiva/Parvati, donate rice/milk on Monday, wear pearl if suitable.
Remedies for afflicted Mars: Hanuman Chalisa on Tuesday, donate red lentils, avoid aggression, wear coral if suitable.
Remedies for weak Mercury: Vishnu Sahasranama on Wednesday, donate green vegetables, practice clear communication, wear emerald if suitable.
Remedies for weak Jupiter: Guru mantra on Thursday, donate yellow cloth/gram, serve teachers, wear yellow sapphire if suitable.
Remedies for weak Venus: Laxmi worship on Friday, donate white items, maintain cleanliness and beauty, wear diamond if suitable.
Remedies for afflicted Saturn: Shani mantra on Saturday, donate black sesame/iron/clothes, serve poor/elderly, wear blue sapphire only after proper advice.
Remedies for afflicted Rahu: Durga Chalisa on Saturday, donate blue/black items, avoid deception, wear hessonite if suitable.
Remedies for afflicted Ketu: Ganesh worship on Tuesday, donate blankets to saints, practice meditation, wear cat's eye only after proper advice.

Vimshottari Mahadasha is calculated from Moon's nakshatra lord. Each planet rules a period: Ketu 7, Venus 20, Sun 6, Moon 10, Mars 7, Rahu 18, Jupiter 16, Saturn 19, Mercury 17 years. Interpretation depends on the dasha lord's house, sign, and aspects.
Sun Mahadasha brings focus on authority, career, father, recognition, and health. Good if Sun is strong; challenging if afflicted.
Moon Mahadasha emphasizes emotions, mother, public, mind, and comfort. Favorable if Moon is strong and waxing.
Mars Mahadasha brings energy, courage, property, siblings, and conflicts. Strong Mars gives success through effort; afflicted Mars creates accidents or disputes.
Rahu Mahadasha can bring sudden rise or fall, foreign connections, materialism, and unconventional paths. Results depend heavily on placement.
Jupiter Mahadasha generally brings wisdom, children, wealth, spirituality, and guidance. Highly beneficial if Jupiter is strong.
Saturn Mahadasha brings discipline, responsibility, delays, hard work, and karmic lessons. Eventually rewarding if Saturn is well-placed.
Mercury Mahadasha emphasizes communication, business, intellect, learning, and trade. Good for education and commerce if Mercury is strong.
Ketu Mahadasha brings detachment, spirituality, sudden events, and karmic completion. Can be difficult materially but enlightening spiritually.
Venus Mahadasha brings relationships, luxury, arts, vehicles, and pleasures. Highly favorable if Venus is strong; problematic if afflicted.
